about: Modwerk source-only live-looper package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/live-looper.

mods.title: Live Looper
mods.summary: A looper machine for one audio track: it records the master mix or the inputs all the time, catches the loop playing now at a button press, and keeps it playing through pattern changes.
mods.description: A looper machine for one audio track: it records the master mix or the inputs all the time, catches the loop playing now at a button press, and keeps it playing through pattern changes.
mods.author: draadpiraat
mods.on_unit: Emulator-checked; the author's hardware run of this build (LL02) is pending. LF03 (with the Crossfader, 2026-11-10) and LL01 (2026-11-12) passed on a Digitakt I, OS 1.54; LL02 has the fixes from LL01's run.
